messages:
marco: Quick question / heads up. My daycare shut today and I need to be home for Bridge Day coverage. I had planned to work remotely but can't for the afternoon. We're in the company Dec 20-31 blackout for PTO. Any options?
julia (People Ops): Sorry Marco. Bridge Day exceptions are handled differently from winter shutdowns but the blackout still applies for formal PTO. Two options: swap hours with a colleague (hour bank) or request a Blackout Exception for emergency childcare.
marco: I don’t have enough PTO left to cover a full day and don’t want unpaid if avoidable.
sam: Manager here 1 I can swap shifts with Marco on Monday morning so he can take the Bridge afternoon. We use the hour-bank swap form usually.
julia (People Ops): Great, Sam. If you're doing an hours swap we need a short confirmation in the swap form + manager sign-off. That avoids consuming PTO. Use: https://forms.company/hours-swap.
luis: For clarity: hours-swap means Marco works Sam’s Monday morning (4 hours) and Sam takes Marco’s Bridge afternoon. Payroll just sees an internal swap, no PTO deducted.
marco: Perfect 1 I prefer the swap. Sam 1 can you fill the swap form?
sam: Filling now. Also pinging Julia to note manager approval.
julia (People Ops): If swap falls through, backup is a PTO advance (manager + People Ops + payroll). Note payroll cutoff: Dec 18 17:00 PT. If we miss cutoff advances may be applied retroactively.
marco: Fingers crossed swap works. Thanks for options.
hr-bot: Reminder: blackout = Dec 20-31. Hours swap form: https://forms.company/hours-swap. Payroll cutoff: Dec 18 17:00 PT.
sam: Swap submitted (form ref HS-9832). Manager approval attached. Noted Marco will cover Monday morning 9-1.
julia (People Ops): Received HS-9832. I'll mark this exception as hours-swap -> no PTO. Marco 1 please confirm you saw the calendar update.
marco: Got it on the calendar. Thank you Sam + People Ops.
julia (People Ops): Quick FYI on carryover: hours swapped or PTO advances do not change year-end carryover caps. If you need to preserve a PTO bucket for carryover, request a PTO advance and note that it still counts against carryover rules.
marco: Noted. Swap is ideal. Appreciate the quick help.
hr-bot: HS-9832 processed. Calendar invites updated. Happy Bridge Day! :sun_with_face:
